title: Ivory Coast challenged in 3-2 win against Gabon
summary: The defending champions were surprised by the Panthers who pounced early on to take a 2-0 lead in the first 21 minutes. Krasso, Guessand and Touré helped the Elephants climb back and secure the top spot of their group, finishing ahead of Cameroon and setting up a Round of 16 game against Burkina Faso.
